errors.evidence: The blue line, representing 'Брой държави в света' (Number of countries in the world), starts at 10 in 2003, not 7. The description incorrectly uses the starting value of the orange line.
The value for the blue line in 2008 is 14, not 9. The value 9 corresponds to the orange line in 2008.
The orange line, representing 'Брой държави в Европа' (Number of countries in Europe), starts at 7 in 2003, not 10. The description incorrectly uses the starting value of the blue line.
The value for the orange line in 2008 is 9, not 6. The line reaches its minimum value of 6 later, around the year 2010.
